basic_details.job_title: KSSTM Junior Mentors Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Kerala State Science & Technology Museum (KSSTM) is filling 2 posts of Junior Mentors on contract at Regional Science Centre, Chalakkudy, on a consolidated pay of Rs. 37,000 per month. The filled-in application form with self-attested copies must be sent to The Director, Kerala State Science & Technology Museum, Vikas Bhavan, Trivandrum 695 033, and must be received by 11 November 2026, the extended last date. Candidates who applied against the earlier notification dated 05.09.2026 need not apply again.

content_sections.heading: About KSSTM
content_sections.text: The Kerala State Science & Technology Museum has its office at Vikas Bhavan, Trivandrum (Thiruvananthapuram). This notice is for posts at its Regional Science Centre, Chalakkudy. The notice says the engagement depends on the requirement of the innovation hub.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form can be downloaded from the website www.kstmuseum.com . The duly filled-in form, along with self-attested copies of certificates in support of date of birth, educational qualifications etc., should be submitted to the address below. The notice does not name a postal mode. The Director, Kerala State Science & Technology Museum, Vikas Bhavan, Trivandrum 695 033 The last date is for receipt of the application: 11 November 2026. The form is printed in the notice as "Application form for the post of Junior Mentors for Regional Science Centre Chalakudy (On Contract Basis)". Candidates who applied in response to the earlier notification dated 05.09.2026 need not apply again. Their applications will also be considered for the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The candidates should have minimum Master's degree in Science / Bachelor's degree in Engineering with 1st class in the branches: Life Sciences / Physical Sciences / Robotics / Computer Science / Electronics / Mechanical Engineering / Mechatronics or Equivalent discipline. 1 year experience in good teaching/research/industry background. Preference shall be given to candidates having lab/R&D/industry/experience in Startup/incubation. Passion for conducting investigative/innovative projects or model making/design activities/experiment specifically with students. 30 years as on the date of this notification. The notice does not print a minimum age or any age relaxation. The engagement is initially for a period of 1 year, depending on the requirement of the innovation hub. It may be extended on mutually agreed terms based on satisfactory performance, subject to a maximum of 2 more years. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates in support of date of birth and educational qualifications. Self-attested copy of the graduation/degree certificate along with the detailed mark sheet and other higher degrees. Self-attested copies of experience certificates. A recent passport size photograph affixed on the form (not to be stapled). The form also asks for details of computer knowledge, training attended, any other relevant information, two references and a list of enclosures. It carries a declaration signed by the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Depending on the number of candidates, there may be a written test and interview, or interview only, for selection. Candidates will be informed of the test or interview. They have to attend at their own expense, and no TA/DA will be disbursed. The notice does not print the test syllabus, marks or date.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application (extended)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An application without self-attested copies of documents will be summarily rejected. The notice says no application fee is to be remitted. In the declaration, the applicant states that there are no vigilance/criminal cases pending against him or her. If any information is found false or incorrect, the candidature will be summarily rejected or employment terminated. If selected, the applicant must be ready to attend duties even on holidays as per requirement of the Museum, against a weekly/compensatory off.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Mentors posts are there in KSSTM?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Junior Mentors at Regional Science Centre, Chalakkudy, on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KSSTM Junior Mentors?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications has been extended till 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for KSSTM Junior Mentors?
faq.answer: Minimum Master's degree in Science / Bachelor's degree in Engineering with 1st class in Life Sciences, Physical Sciences, Robotics, Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or an equivalent discipline. The notice also asks for 1 year experience in a good teaching/research/industry background.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for KSSTM Junior Mentors?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years as on the date of this notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a KSSTM Junior Mentor?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for KSSTM Junior Mentors?
faq.answer: The notice states that no application fee is to be remitted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for KSSTM Junior Mentors?
faq.answer: Download the application form from www.kstmuseum.com, fill it in, attach self-attested copies of certificates, and submit it to The Director, Kerala State Science & Technology Museum, Vikas Bhavan, Trivandrum 695 033, to reach by 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates who applied earlier need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who applied against the earlier notification dated 05.09.2026 need not apply again, and their applications will also be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q9. How are Junior Mentors selected?
faq.answer: Depending on the number of candidates, selection may be by a written test and interview or by interview only, under intimation to candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is the KSSTM Junior Mentors job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract. The engagement is initially for 1 year and may be extended on mutually agreed terms based on satisfactory performance, subject to a maximum of 2 more years.
